a.speaker: Teo Lisk
a.text: Teo is on his ladder again. He climbs down holding a silver pouch. "Shielding bag. I sealed spares for the radio club and had one left. Anything sealed in here should ride out a pulse that kills everything plugged in. Want it?"

how.speaker: Teo Lisk
how.text:
"Small electronics only. Fold the top twice, tape it, test it with your phone: no signal, good seal."

[How it works] In your garage, tap a device under Seal to put it in the bag. Sealed gear almost always survives the flash; unsealed electronics usually do not. Vehicles load by weight, and hardening steps lower the chance the engine dies.
